Additionally, critical distinguishing features like the ejection port and sights are missing or fused, reducing the fidelity of the generation.

Secondary defects include the fusion of the trigger guard into the pistol grip (Severity 3.0) and the lack of defined mechanical features on the upper receiver (Severity 2.5).
